examples.name: Confirm
examples.summary: A removal: title, one sentence of what happens, Cancel and a danger confirm button; closed behind a visible trigger.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import ConfirmDialog from '@aziontech/webkit/confirm-dialog'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <ConfirmDialog
    v-model:open="open"
    title="Remove domain"
    description="shop.example.com stops answering for this resource once you save. Traffic already pointed at it gets no response."
    confirm-label="Remove Domain"
    @confirm="open = false"
  >
    <template #trigger>
      <Button
        label="Remove domain"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </ConfirmDialog>
</template>

examples.name: DiscardChanges
examples.summary: The unsaved-changes guard on a form that cannot be saved from the dialog: Keep editing returns to the form and the danger Discard changes leaves it.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import ConfirmDialog from '@aziontech/webkit/confirm-dialog'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <ConfirmDialog
    v-model:open="open"
    title="Unsaved changes"
    description="This page has changes you haven't saved. If you leave now, they're discarded."
    cancel-label="Keep editing"
    confirm-label="Discard changes"
    @confirm="open = false"
  >
    <template #trigger>
      <Button
        label="Leave page"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </ConfirmDialog>
</template>

examples.name: RunAgain
examples.summary: A commit rather than a removal, so the confirm button is primary (`kind="primary"`).
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import ConfirmDialog from '@aziontech/webkit/confirm-dialog'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <ConfirmDialog
    v-model:open="open"
    title="Clear cached content again?"
    description="This clears the same 2 URLs from the Edge cache again. Each object is fetched from your origin on its next request."
    confirm-label="Clear again"
    kind="primary"
    @confirm="open = false"
  >
    <template #trigger>
      <Button
        label="Run again"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </ConfirmDialog>
</template>
